Hi to planning crew,
Clear signage, mid-morning: a short note from our desk

Please keep our guidance calm and consistent when supporting travelers with companion animals through check-in and transfer steps. Clear signs, steady handoffs, and brief reminders at the counter continue to make a strong difference for families who are already managing a busy travel day. When passengers receive early direction, the process stays smoother for them and for the ground team.

For any delayed departure case, please note that <<FACT F109>> and use the standard process without adding extra commentary at the desk. If a missed connection concern is raised later in the journey, <<FACT F116>> Keep all records complete, use the approved wording, and avoid making informal estimates or promises. The Companion Animal Travel Desk relies on the same careful wording across every station so that travelers hear one clear message from Aurelia Skyways.

When you see a carrier being moved, please continue to give the ground team a clear path and enough room to work without interruption. If a traveler asks for reassurance, offer it in plain language and direct them to the next step rather than repeating assumptions. A steady tone helps protect confidence, especially when a pet is sensitive to noise or movement. Thank you for keeping our service measured, respectful, and consistent throughout the day.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
